columns.businessDescription: Content identifier — the natural key of the library, and the one path segment of the retrieval URL

source.filter: VERSION = 'C' AND (DISABLED_FLAG IS NULL OR DISABLED_FLAG <> 'Y') AND CONTENT_ID IS NOT NULL

columns.notes: Entity-key column. The filter here is the ENTITY filter (the intake contract has no entity-level filter field — program's precedent): version 'C' is the current row, disabled rows and null keys are out. Live-measured 2026-09-03: contentId is effectively unique at version 'C' (6,561,618 distinct / 6,561,622 rows; the 4 duplicates are full-key duplicate rows deduped latest-by-LAST_UPDATE_DATE in the SQL). The composite key originally proposed (contentId+type+owningMarket+audience+geoVisibility) adds zero uniqueness, and geo-visibility does not exist in this source at all — it is a product-side assignment attribute (EAV group 1181).
